The tool **web_search** had calls that returned an error before October 28 2026, with **1** errored call.

```json
{
  "question": "Which tools had calls that returned an error before October 28, 2026, and how many errored calls did each have?",
  "sql": "SELECT tool_name, COUNT(*) AS errored_calls\nFROM tool_calls\nWHERE error IS NOT NULL\n  AND called_at < '2026-10-28'\nGROUP BY tool_name\nORDER BY errored_calls DESC;",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "The web_search tool had 1 errored call before October 28, 2026."
}
```
